name: sock
description: Message your human through sock: hooks for permission and idle prompts, the sock-mcp tools and the Claude Code channel.

sock_token.title: sock machine key or puppet token
sock_token.description: A sock_mk_ machine key (sock machine-key create): every project gets its own puppet, named <project> on <host>. Or a sock_pt_ puppet token: one puppet for every session on this machine.

sock_url.title: sock server URL
sock_url.description: Leave as is unless you run your own server.

notify_on_stop.title: Message at the end of every turn
notify_on_stop.description: Send a sock message each time Claude finishes a turn. Off by default.
